title: How To Decode Egg Labels For The Healthiest Choice
summary: Diet doctor's egg-shopping advice favouring organic, pasture-raised, corn- and soy-free eggs.

assertions.quote: organic eggs are fed organic feed so that's going to have less pesticides which means less bioaccumulation of pesticides into the eggs

verdicts.note: Organic feed lowers pesticide inputs, but residues in conventional eggs are already rare and very low.
